output_tail: Worldbook snapshots: transitions, drafts, shared books, eligibility, groups and recovery passed.
Worldbook bundles passed: defaults, chat locks, editing, rollback, group plans, conflicts and stale drafts.
Character worldbook identity passed: duplicate names, current/avatar lookup, one-call reads, stale context, snapshot binding/restore and old snapshot safety.
中控保存回归通过：独立/主界面下重置即时同步、保存不关闭、数值/界面即时同步、输入法草稿提交、旧滑杆帧不能覆盖新数值、滑杆继续可用、保存提示、失败保护及保存后取消/重载。
条幅宽度契约通过：旧保存值迁移、首次内容默认、独立 profile、默认持久化、数值逐帧预览及取消/保存。
作者整合运行回归通过：搜索、原生入口与清理，以及轻量快照保存/取消时的正文草稿与重启缓存隔离。
真实 Chromium 回归通过：5 类屏幕、最终 clip、唯一入口、内容默认/重置、保存/reload/重挂载、八种正文状态在浅/深宿主背景下可读，材质不变。
Phone performance regression passed: phone landscape

Floating dock browser passed: short inward detach, release/reload, cancel, redock, immediate opening, native edge shape, skin follow and zero gesture reads.
